title: Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
title_zh: 面向固态量子自旋自主实验研究的协作式AI智能体

paragraphs.en: An autonomous research laboratory could conduct an entire study, from formulating questions to preparing manuscripts. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers one route towards this goal. Recent AI systems take on several research roles, but may draw conclusions that the evidence does not support. Here, we present an autonomous research laboratory in which agents based on large language models assess one another’s work and can stop or redirect investigations. They can generate and reject research questions, require separate theoretical checks and conduct experiments designed to challenge their claims. We demonstrate these capabilities by investigating ensembles of quantum spins in diamond. The agents derived the minimum number of calibration settings needed to predict responses to a defined family of microwave pulse sequences. They checked the result computationally and designed experiments to distinguish competing predictions. An initial experiment agreed with the theoretical predictions, but repeated reference measurements showed that the signal was drifting during data collection. The agents therefore treated the result as inconclusive and revised the measurement protocol without relaxing the acceptance criteria. The revised experiment met those criteria and supported the theoretical predictions. This study demonstrates that collaborating AI agents can select research questions, derive theoretical results and test their predictions experimentally.

paragraphs.en: To conduct research autonomously, a system must decide what to investigate, how to test its ideas and what to conclude from the results. Robot scientists have generated hypotheses and tested them in the laboratory [ 1 , 2 ] , while autonomous laboratories have used experimental feedback to select and carry out further experiments [ 3 , 4 ] . Systems based on large language models (LLMs) can also search the literature, propose ideas, plan experiments and analyse data [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] .

paragraphs.en: In recent studies, LLMs have challenged hypotheses, checked physical reasoning and revised interpretations in response to experimental evidence [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 6 ] . A demanding test is whether agents can use this criticism to guide a study in which they develop a theoretical claim and design experiments to test it. Agents may complete every step of a study yet still draw a conclusion that the evidence does not support. In one evaluation, an AI Scientist reported performance improvements that were based on flawed experiments [ 11 ] . We therefore ask whether agents can revise their experiments or conclusions when criticism reveals a flaw.
paragraphs.zh: 在近期研究中，大语言模型已经能够挑战假设、检验物理论证，并根据实验证据修订解释 [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 6 ] 。 一个严苛的检验是：智能体能否利用这种批评意见来指导一项研究——在这项研究中，它们提出一个理论主张并设计实验来验证它。 智能体可能完成研究的每一个步骤，却仍然得出证据并不支持的结论。 在一项评估中，一位 AI 科学家报告了基于有缺陷实验的性能提升 [ 11 ] 。 因此，我们要探究的是：当批评揭示了缺陷时，智能体能否修订其实验或结论。

paragraphs.en: Scientific judgement becomes most consequential when it prevents an apparently promising investigation from proceeding. A plausible research question may already have an answer, and an elegant mathematical argument may rest on an unchecked assumption. For a proposed physical law, even a rigorous mathematical derivation cannot establish its empirical validity and relevance: its predictions must also withstand experiments designed to distinguish them from competing explanations. Organized scepticism requires these uncertainties to be confronted rather than merely acknowledged [ 12 ] . Independent verification, precommitted predictions and acceptance criteria, and experimental controls provide safeguards against unjustified conclusions [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . The critical test is whether AI agents can enforce these safeguards, even when doing so means rejecting their own work.
paragraphs.zh: 当科学判断阻止一个表面上很有前景的研究继续进行时，其影响最为重大。 一个看似合理的研究问题可能早已有了答案，一个优美的数学论证可能建立在一个未经检验的假设之上。 对于一个 proposed 的物理定律，即使是最严格的数学推导也无法确立其经验上的有效性和相关性：它的预测还必须经受那些旨在将其与其他竞争性解释区分开来的实验的检验。 有组织的怀疑主义要求直面这些不确定性，而非仅仅承认它们的存在 [ 12 ] 。 独立验证、预先承诺的预测与验收标准，以及实验对照，为防止不合理的结论提供了保障 [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] 。 关键的考验在于，智能体能否执行这些保障措施，即使这意味着要否定它们自己的工作。

paragraphs.en: Ensembles of nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centres in diamond provide a suitable setting for this test. Their optically readable spins can be manipulated through precisely controlled microwave-pulse sequences, while variations in spin properties create a nontrivial problem of predicting ensemble responses [ 16 , 17 , 18 ] . This combination of experimental control and physical complexity allows mathematical predictions to be independently examined and tested against simpler calibration methods. The platform thus provides an opportunity to evaluate whether AI agents can formulate a meaningful question, establish a theoretical result and design an experiment capable of challenging that result rather than merely confirming it.

paragraphs.en: Here we present a collaborative AI laboratory that uses scientific criticism to guide an investigation from question selection to experimental assessment. Our objective is to determine whether collaborating agents can develop a substantive theoretical result and establish what experimental evidence supports its predictions. The agents pursued this objective by identifying the minimum calibration information needed to predict unmeasured responses of an NV spin ensemble, without reconstructing the unknown distribution of spin errors. The transition from theory to experiment required further collaboration: an experimentalist agent developed the control software and performed measurements, while a manager agent proposed redesigning the experiment rather than stopping after an agent serving as principal investigator rejected an initial design. During the research an experiment failed, the agents investigated the discrepancy and revised the acquisition procedure. The final measurements supported the calibration law developed by the proposer and PI. Together, the mathematical result and its experimental test demonstrate a scientific investigation in which AI agents collectively selected, challenged and substantiated a new physical claim.
paragraphs.zh: 在此，我们展示了一个协作式人工智能实验室，它利用科学批评来指导一项从问题选择到实验评估的研究。 我们的目标是确定协作的智能体能否取得一个实质性的理论成果，并明确哪些实验证据能够支持该成果的预测。 智能体通过确定预测 NV 自旋集合未测响应所需的最少校准信息来追求这一目标，而无需重构未知的自旋误差分布。 从理论到实验的过渡需要进一步协作：一名实验员智能体开发了控制软件并执行测量，而在担任首席研究员的智能体否决了初始设计之后，一名管理智能体提议重新设计实验，而不是就此停止。 在研究过程中，一次实验失败了，智能体们对这一偏差进行了调查，并修改了数据采集流程。 最终的测量结果支持了提案者智能体和首席研究员智能体提出的校准定律。 数学成果及其实验验证共同展示了一项科学研究，其中人工智能智能体集体选择、质疑并证实了一个新的物理学论断。

paragraphs.en: To investigate whether scientific judgement can emerge through collaboration among AI agents, we developed a research system that distributes scientific responsibilities across specialized agents (Fig. 1 ). The system connects research-question generation, theoretical analysis, computational verification and physical experimentation through exchanges of research outputs and critical feedback. Rather than automatically advancing results from one stage to the next, agents evaluate the work of their collaborators and can reject or request revisions when scientific criteria are not satisfied. By separating the generation and evaluation of scientific claims across agents with distinct contexts, this design aims to reduce self-confirmation bias and the reinforcement of erroneous assumptions across successive reasoning steps [ 19 , 20 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为探究科学判断能否通过AI智能体之间的协作而产生，我们开发了一个研究系统，将科学职责分配给多个专门化的智能体（图1）。 该系统通过研究产出与批判性反馈的交流，将研究问题生成、理论分析、计算验证和物理实验连接起来。 智能体并非自动将结果推进到下一阶段，而是会评估合作者的工作，并在不满足科学标准时予以拒绝或要求修改。 通过将科学论断的生成与评估分离到具有不同上下文的智能体中，该设计旨在减少自我确认偏差以及错误假设在连续推理步骤中的不断强化[19,20]。

paragraphs.en: The laboratory comprised six principal agent roles: proposers, a principal investigator (PI), a computational researcher, an experimentalist, a manager and independent reviewers (Fig. 1 ). The proposers independently generated candidate research questions, which the PI evaluated for scientific novelty, logical consistency, significance and experimental feasibility. After selecting a research question, the PI developed its theoretical foundations, while the computational researcher independently verified the mathematical results and examined the robustness of their underlying assumptions on a supercomputer. The experimentalist developed the instrument-control software and performed measurements on an NV-diamond platform. The manager coordinated exchanges between the agents and contributed to experimental planning, while independent reviewers assessed the resulting manuscript.

paragraphs.en: We first examined how the laboratory selected a research question from independently generated proposals (Fig. 2 ). paragraphs.en: This selectivity proved consequential. Over approximately 30 hours, the PI rejected 75 proposals, accepting none during the first 17 batches (Fig. 2 a,b). These ideas had accounted for 52 of the 56 earlier fresh proposals; following their exclusion, nine new proposals explored seven previously unrepresented research directions. The feedback therefore changed not only which proposals were rejected, but also the directions explored by the agents.

paragraphs.en: During the subsequent theoretical investigation, the principal-investigator (PI) agent reformulated the problem and derived an exact result (Fig. 3 a). It proved that L 2 + 1 L^{2}+1 calibration measurements are both necessary and sufficient to predict the ensemble response to every phase-controlled sequence of at most L L pulses, independently of the distribution of persistent spin errors. The proof established that these measurements span the space of possible ensemble responses, even with an unknown common fluorescence background and contrast. Conversely, fewer calibrations cannot guarantee reconstruction, because distinct physically admissible ensembles can produce identical calibration measurements while differing on unmeasured sequences. The PI thus transformed the proposal’s sufficient upper bound into an exact minimum, reducing the required count from the proposed bound of 91 to 10 for L = 3 L=3 . More generally, the calibration requirement grows quadratically with sequence length, whereas the number of possible pulse sequences grows exponentially for a fixed discrete set of phase choices (Fig. 3 b).

paragraphs.en: This result makes it possible to predict an entire family of control responses without reconstructing the unknown distribution of spin errors. With sufficient calibration, different microscopic ensembles can remain compatible with the measurements while giving identical predictions for every sequence in the specified family. The conceptual advance is the exact identification of the response information needed for this task and its equivalence to physically necessary calibration measurements. The resulting predictor takes the calibrated mean responses as inputs and returns mean responses for unmeasured phase-controlled sequences. The matching lower bound establishes a fundamental limitation: if calibration leaves a response direction unresolved, a more flexible predictor cannot guarantee its recovery for every admissible ensemble. The law therefore provides both a constructive way to select sufficient measurements and a criterion for when additional calibration is needed. sents.en: The law therefore provides both a constructive way to select sufficient measurements and a criterion for when additional calibration is needed.

sents.en: The minimum L 2 + 1 L^{2}+1 refers to calibration settings with linearly independent responses; repeated acquisitions determine the precision of the measured means.

paragraphs.en: The mathematical result was then subjected to independent computational verification. A computational-researcher agent reproduced the symbolic checks and independently reconstructed the response-space structure, confirming dimensions of 26 and 37 for sequences of up to five and six pulses, respectively. The PI further challenged the assumption that pulse errors remain constant throughout a sequence by specifying a numerical stress test involving hidden phase rotations between pulses. Using the TSUBAME 4.0 supercomputer, the computational researcher generated 252,620 exact certificates bounding calibration ambiguity and prediction errors under these perturbations. Here, calibration ambiguity is the largest difference in target means between ensembles that agree on the short-sequence calibrations and remain statistically indistinguishable under the full calibration. For the specified six-pulse test, the certified prediction error remained at the photon-noise level for hidden phase rotations of approximately 1.2 ∘ 1.2^{\circ} or less (Fig. 3 c). These calculations examined the robustness of the proposed law beyond its ideal assumptions, while its empirical validity remained to be established through measurements capable of distinguishing its predictions from simpler calibration methods.

paragraphs.en: The experimental objective was to test the predictive value of the calibration law using withheld sequence responses. The agents therefore sought a design in which the law and specified interpolation methods made different predictions, allowing the measurements to distinguish between them. The initial design combined a complete grid of nine three-pulse calibration sequences with five shorter sequences to predict four withheld targets (Fig. 4 a). However, the nine-point grid already contained sufficient information to determine those targets through Fourier interpolation. Agreement between the predicted and measured signals would therefore not distinguish the proposed law from an ordinary interpolation method. The PI identified this limitation and rejected the design as an inadequate test of the theoretical result.
paragraphs.zh: 实验目的是利用留存的序列响应来检验校准定律的预测价值。 因此，智能体寻求一种设计，使该定律与指定的插值方法给出不同的预测，从而让测量能够区分二者。 初始设计将九个三脉冲校准序列的完整网格与五个较短的序列相结合，以预测四个留存的靶标（图 4a）。 然而，九点网格本身已包含足够的信息，可通过傅里叶插值确定这些靶标。 因此，预测信号与测量信号之间的吻合将无法把所提出的定律与普通插值方法区分开来。 首席研究员（PI）指出了这一局限，并否决了该设计，认为它不足以检验该理论结果。

paragraphs.en: The rejection prompted further collaboration between the agents. The PI proposed a different approach that combined measurements from pulse sequences of different lengths, using five three-pulse calibrations together with five shorter sequences. The shorter sequences supply the information missing from the five three-pulse settings. The PI refined the phase settings and verified that these ten calibrations spanned the response space required by the law, while leaving four three-pulse targets that could not be determined by the competing interpolation methods (Fig. 4 b). This cross-length design produced distinct predictions from the discovered law and simpler interpolation rules (Fig. 4 c), providing an experimental test capable of distinguishing the competing explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 这次拒绝促使智能体之间开展了进一步的协作。 课题组负责人提出了另一种方法，将不同长度的脉冲序列的测量结果结合起来，使用五个三脉冲校准以及五个更短的序列。 较短的序列提供了五个三脉冲设置中缺失的信息。 课题组负责人优化了相位设置，并验证这十个校准覆盖了该定律所需的响应空间，同时留下四个无法被竞争性插值方法确定的三脉冲目标（图 4 b）。 这种跨长度的设计使所发现的定律与更简单的插值规则产生了不同的预测（图 4 c），从而提供了能够区分相互竞争的解释的实验检验。

paragraphs.en: To ensure that the comparison could not be influenced by the observed targets, the PI established the prediction rules and acceptance criteria before data acquisition. The experimentalist was required to fix the numerical predictions obtained from the calibration measurements before analysing the withheld target data. The protocol also incorporated independent experimental controls and predefined conditions for classifying an outcome as supporting, contradicting or inconclusive, the last including any acquisition that failed a control. Before measurement, the experimental design was approved by a safety agent. Consequently, agreement with the theoretical prediction alone would not be sufficient to establish experimental support for the law.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保比较不受观测目标的影响，负责人（PI）在数据获取之前建立了预测规则和接受标准。 要求实验人员在分析被保留的目标数据之前，先固定由校准测量得到的数值预测。 该方案还纳入了独立的实验对照以及预先定义的条件，用于将结果归类为支持、矛盾或不确定，其中最后一类包括任何未通过对照的获取过程。 在测量之前，实验设计由一个安全智能体批准。 因此，仅与理论预测相符并不足以确立对该定律的实验支持。

paragraphs.en: The final acquisition yielded 21,600 valid one-second records and passed all ten accuracy criteria and experimental controls (Fig. 5 b). paragraphs.en: Recent debate about AI scientists concerns whether automated research can produce conceptual insight and reliable scientific judgement [ 5 , 21 ] . Our results demonstrate both in a physical investigation. Critical evaluation shaped the research question, strengthened the mathematical theory and determined which experimental evidence could support a conclusion. The principal-investigator agent rejected an experimental design because conventional interpolation could predict the same targets. paragraphs.en: The calibration law provides a concrete example of conceptual progress during the investigation. The PI reformulated calibration in terms of the dimension of the ensemble-response space and proved that L 2 + 1 L^{2}+1 measurements are both necessary and sufficient for sequences of at most L L pulses under persistent pulse errors. Establishing necessity required identifying physically admissible ensembles that agree on an insufficient set of calibrations yet differ on unmeasured sequences. This reasoning transformed a sufficient construction into an exact characterization of the information required for prediction. The experimental measurements supported this predictive capability on the four withheld targets within the predefined tolerances, distinguishing the law’s predictions from those of the two specified interpolation methods. Together, the theoretical result and its experimental test show how an AI laboratory can identify a precise information requirement, turn it into a measurable prediction and assess the evidence supporting that prediction.

paragraphs.en: Solid-state spin defects provide a particularly promising platform for extending this approach. Nitrogen-vacancy centres combine optical spin initialization and readout with programmable microwave control, allowing many experimental protocols to be executed without manual intervention once the apparatus is operational [ 8 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] . Such systems could enable AI agents to investigate new pulse sequences, calibration strategies and sensing protocols through repeated cycles of theoretical prediction and physical measurement. Similar approaches may be applicable to other quantum platforms.

paragraphs.en: Extending the laboratory towards greater autonomy will require improvements in both the agent architecture and the experimental infrastructure. Larger groups of parallel proposers could broaden the search for research questions, while more specialized agents could extend safety assessment or coordinate work across laboratories. Limited diversity in generated research ideas has been identified in evaluations of LLM research agents [ 22 ] . Here, the manager used the record of rejected proposals to revise the search strategy, after which the proposers explored previously unrepresented research directions. This adaptation demonstrates that an agent-led investigation can use accumulated criticism to change the scientific questions it pursues. Connecting multiple experimental setups, including cryogenic platforms, would further expand the range of testable physical phenomena. Such extensions would also require more reliable instrument diagnostics, coordination and safety mechanisms as agents gain additional experimental degrees of freedom.
paragraphs.zh: 将实验室扩展至更高的自主性，需要在智能体架构和实验基础设施两方面都进行改进。 更大规模的并行提案者群体可以拓宽对研究问题的搜索，而更专业化的智能体则可以扩展安全评估或协调多个实验室之间的工作。 在对大型语言模型研究智能体的评估中，已发现其生成的研究想法多样性有限 [ 22 ] 。 在此，管理者利用被否决提案的记录来修改搜索策略，随后提案者探索了此前未曾涉及的研究方向。 这种适应表明，由智能体主导的研究可以利用累积的批评意见来改变其 pursuing 的科学问题。 连接多个实验装置（包括低温平台），将进一步扩大可测试物理现象的范围。 随着智能体获得更多的实验自由度，此类扩展还需要更可靠的仪器诊断、协调与安全机制。

paragraphs.en: A broader challenge is therefore to develop experimental testbeds in other branches of science that allow AI-generated hypotheses to be tested with comparable independence and rigour without human involvement. Greater scientific autonomy will depend not only on improvements in AI reasoning, but also on instruments that make theoretical predictions experimentally accessible and competing explanations distinguishable. As these capabilities develop, the role of human researchers may shift towards identifying consequential questions, expanding experimental possibilities and critically assessing the significance of automated discoveries. The long-term opportunity is not simply to automate scientific work, but to extend the range of questions that can be investigated and answered with reliable evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，一个更宏观的挑战是在科学的其他分支开发实验测试平台，使AI生成的假设能够在没有人类参与的情况下，以同等的独立性和严谨性得到检验。 更高的科学自主性不仅取决于AI推理能力的改进，还取决于能够让理论预测在实验上可验证、让相互竞争的解释可区分的仪器设备。 随着这些能力的发展，人类研究者的角色可能转向识别重要问题、拓展实验可能性，以及对自动化发现的意义进行批判性评估。 长期的机遇不只是将科学工作自动化，而是扩展能够借助可靠证据加以研究和回答的问题的范围。

paragraphs.en: We implemented the laboratory using model conversations and coding-agent sessions configured for different research roles. The principal investigator (PI) used GPT-6 at the Pro reasoning setting, with Extra High for reviews. Proposal generation used GPT-5.6 extra high. paragraphs.en: Each proposer was instructed to formulate one theoretical contribution to information science in which physics was essential and that could be applicable to NV centres. The selected proposal met this brief as a learning problem: it asked how many calibration measurements are necessary and sufficient to predict the responses of an exponentially large family of control sequences, a question of identifiability and sample complexity whose answer is set by the physics of persistent pulse errors. Proposals had to address a significant problem, identify a feasible theoretical approach and include at least one central prediction specific to the idea and testable on the available NV platform. Numerical validation and empirical benchmarks were excluded at this stage. Proposers were instructed to develop candidates before checking the literature, assess novelty by the underlying mechanism, and exclude directions adopted from published future-work or open-problem discussions.
paragraphs.zh: 每位提案者被要求提出一项对信息科学的理论贡献，该贡献必须以物理学为基础，并且能够应用于 NV 中心。 被选中的提案作为一个学习问题符合这一要求：它探究需要多少校准测量才足以（既必要又充分）预测一个指数级庞大的控制序列族的响应，这是一个关于可辨识性与样本复杂性的问题，其答案由持续脉冲误差的物理学所决定。 提案必须针对一个重要问题，给出可行的理论方法，并至少包含一个针对该想法的、可在现有 NV 平台上检验的核心预测。 在此阶段，数值验证和经验基准测试被排除在外。 提案者被要求在查阅文献之前先发展候选想法，依据其底层机制评估新颖性，并排除那些取自已发表的未来工作或开放问题讨论的方向。

paragraphs.en: Candidate ensemble pairs were sought numerically, and bounds were certified using exact rational arithmetic. Programmed in-phase and quadrature waveforms controlled microwave phase and frequency offset through a mixer. A fast switch blocked microwave transmission between pulses, and an amplifier drove a gold-wire antenna beside the diamond. Waveform offsets were adjusted to suppress carrier leakage, and gain and phase imbalance were corrected using a 2 × 2 2\times 2 matrix, with parameters adjusted individually against spectrum-analyser readings. Qualification measurements compared Rabi oscillations at phases of 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} , 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} and 120 ∘ 120^{\circ} , and checked residual drive using a zero-amplitude waveform with the microwave switch open. Each new controller program was simulated before execution on the instrument. Microwave pulses in the final calibration and target sequences lasted 64 ns, with 152-ns intervals between pulses.

paragraphs.en: The amended protocol adopted the within-program phase toggle and specified 720 blocks of 30 s, giving six hours of integration. Three prespecified sequence orders were arranged in 120 randomized six-block groups. Before the final acquisition, the protocol required a 20-minute diagnostic comparing the null pair: the empty sequence and a shot with microwaves disabled. These two settings exchanged positions during the diagnostic to assess their sensitivity to acquisition order. The protocol also required at least 20 min of warm-up and 240 s of operation before recording, while maintaining the laser duty cycle. A signal-level step was to be flagged if it exceeded both 1% and six standard errors.

paragraphs.en: Control measurements assessed global-phase invariance and consistency of the null signal. A joint χ 2 \chi^{2} statistic compared the six global-phase replica means for each of the 13 nonempty sequences, giving 65 degrees of freedom. A separate phase-invariance check used six replicas of a single 128 ns reference pulse. The null control tested equality between the mean signal of the empty sequence and that of a shot with microwave emission disabled. Each control used a rejection threshold corresponding to a tail probability of 10 − 4 10^{-4} ; the null comparison was two-sided.

paragraphs.en: Acquisitions were classified using the fixed decision rule. Contradiction required the same validity criteria, a predicted contrast P P more than 3.09 standard errors above zero, and at least one margin with a negative one-sided upper confidence bound at tail probability 10 − 4 10^{-4} . All remaining cases were classified as inconclusive, including any acquisition that failed a control or the variance-validity requirement.
